name: knowledge
description: The shared search of the platform: store internal documents, let other apps deliver their content, and find the relevant passages with their source. With a model configured by the operator, search also ranks by meaning and answer writes a short answer that cites the passages; without one, search is full text and the calling agent writes the answer itself.

requiredTables.name: documents
requiredTables.description: Stored documents with title, source and full text. Documents delivered by another app carry source_app, source_key (unique per pair) and source_path for the link back. Deleted documents stay with deleted_at set and are invisible to search.

requiredTables.name: chunks
requiredTables.description: Sections of the documents, about 800 characters with overlap, with an English and a German full-text index (tsvector, GIN).

requiredTables.name: chunk_embeddings
requiredTables.description: One vector per section and embedding model (provider/model/dimension), in the pgvector type extensions.vector without a fixed dimension. withheld marks sections the platform kept from an external provider (local-only apps); they are only found through full text. Empty without an embedding model.

requiredTables.name: embedding_state
requiredTables.description: One row: the current embedding model, when it was last checked, the last error and until when the backfill pauses (daily share of the token limit used up).

offeredTools.name: search
offeredTools.description: Searches internal documents and content other apps delivered (e.g. wiki pages) for passages on a question: German and English full text, and by meaning if an embedding model is configured. Returns passages with chunkId, documentId, documentTitle, source, sourceApp, sourceUrl, excerpt (matches in «») and text. Content from apps the caller may not read never appears. Answer only from these passages and cite the source. An empty list means nothing was found: do not guess.

offeredTools.name: answer
offeredTools.description: Answers a question from passages the caller may read, with citations: {status: answered, answer, citations: [{chunkId, documentTitle, sourceUrl, ...}], passages}. Every citation is checked; an answer without a valid one is discarded and comes back as {status: no_answer, reason, passages}: then answer from those passages yourself, do not guess. Without a chat model: {status: not_configured}, use search. Args: question (1-500 chars), limit (1-20, default 8).

offeredTools.name: documents.search
offeredTools.description: Finds documents stored in Knowledge itself by their content (German and English full-text search), one hit per document: {hits: [{id, title, snippet, url, kind}]}, url is the document path (/documents/<id>), kind is document. Content other apps delivered is not included; it is found in those apps. Arguments: query (1 to 200 characters), limit (1 to 20, default 5). Knowledge's tool for the platform search. To answer questions use search.

offeredTools.name: documents.add
offeredTools.description: Stores a document: title, content (plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines) and optionally source (e.g. a URL or "Handbook v3"). Splits the text into searchable sections and returns id and chunkCount. The document can be found through search right away.

offeredTools.name: documents.list
offeredTools.description: Lists the stored documents the caller can see (without full text), newest first, at most 200. Documents from other apps carry sourceApp and sourceUrl. Optional q filters by title or source. For questions about content use search, not this tool.

offeredTools.name: documents.get
offeredTools.description: Reads a document with full text by its id (documentId from search or documents.list). With includeChunks: true the sections with chunkId and ord are included. Deleted documents and documents from apps the caller may not read return 404.

offeredTools.name: documents.delete
offeredTools.description: Deletes a document by its id. The document and its sections no longer appear in search or documents.list. Documents delivered by another app (sourceApp set) cannot be deleted here; they are removed in that app. Only call this when the user explicitly asks for it.

offeredTools.name: documents.upsert
offeredTools.description: For apps only: stores or replaces the calling app's own document with this key (key, title, content, optional source, path for the link back, updatedAt), sections included, in one transaction. The source app comes from the verified caller identity, never from the arguments, so an app can only replace its own content. An older updatedAt than the stored one is ignored (status stale). Humans and agents use documents.add.

offeredTools.name: documents.remove
offeredTools.description: For apps only: removes the calling app's own document with this key, sections included. The source app comes from the verified caller identity, so an app can only remove its own content. Idempotent: removed is false if there was nothing to remove.

offeredTools.name: embeddings.status
offeredTools.description: Shows whether search is hybrid or full text only for the caller, which embedding model is used, how many of the visible sections are embedded, withheld (local-only apps, external provider) or pending, old vectors still waiting to be removed after a model change, the last error, and the backfill progress: dailyShare of the token limit, allowanceToday, pendingTokens, estimatedDays, pausedUntil. No arguments.

offeredTools.name: embeddings.backfill
offeredTools.description: Embeds pending sections now, as many as fit into about 20 seconds and into today's share of the token limit; the rest follows in the background, the next UTC day at the latest. Retries withheld sections and lifts a pause after an error, never the daily share. Use after configuring or changing the embedding model, or when embeddings.status shows an error. Returns {retriedWithheld, embedded, withheld, pending, removedOld, stopped, status}.

requestedGrants.reason: Who may open the app and search. Which group is decided by the grant in the control plane — a requested right is an application, not a grant.
Agents should be able to find internal documents as sources for their answers. Which agent is decided by the grant in the control plane.
Agents may let Knowledge write a short answer with checked citations. It uses the platform model and counts on app:knowledge. Which agent is decided by the grant in the control plane.

Knowledge embeds its sections and search queries with the platform model, if the operator configured one (ADR 0025). Without this grant or without a model, search stays full text; saving is never affected.
Knowledge writes the answer of the tool answer with the platform model, only from passages the caller may read. Without this grant or without a model, answer reports not_configured.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Connection to the app's own schema, with the app role. Set by the control plane.

env.name: DATABASE_SCHEMA
env.description: The app's own schema. The SDK derives the search_path from it; a DSN with options= is rejected.

env.name: OPENAPPS_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: The app's own secret, used by the SDK to verify the gateway signature. Set by the control plane per deployment.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_ID
env.description: Id of this app in the signature material. Must match byte-for-byte what the gateway writes.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_HOST
env.description: Shared domain in the signature material, trimmed and lowercased.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_BASE_PATH
env.description: Path the app lives under (/knowledge). Must be set at build time, otherwise links and images point nowhere.

env.name: OPENAPPS_PLATFORM_URL
env.description: Address of the control plane in the platform network. Knowledge reaches the platform model through it (model_info, embed, generate). Set by the control plane.

env.name: OPENAPPS_CALL_SECRET
env.description: The app's own secret for calls to the platform. Set by the control plane per deployment; never logged.

egress.reason: Calls to the platform model go through the control plane (OPENAPPS_PLATFORM_URL): model_info, embed and generate. The key of the model provider never reaches Knowledge.
